translation: Non-toxic. It mainly warms the center, sends qi downward, breaks phlegm, frees the water passage, opens the chest, removes throat bi [喉痹], [treats] nasal wind epilepsy, mania and epilepsy, sends down milk binding, [treats] failure to come out, and blood not moving; it settles the five viscera, benefits the liver and gallbladder, and frees essence qi. It grows in Huayin.
